common: Use case: product-mockup. Generate ONE finished photorealistic food photograph for a premium warm Fox Coffee mobile website, NOT a UI mockup. Portrait aspect ratio exactly 1:2 (1024x2048). Full bleed scene, no border, text, lettering, numbers, logos, menus or collage. Exactly ONE product, fully visible with its whole plate/saucer and handle. Position the entire product including plate inside x=12%..88%, y=33%..63% of the image, horizontally centered. The product must be large and appetizing but remain inside these bounds; top 30% and bottom 30% are atmospheric background for overlay interface. Product sharp, naturally realistic texture, editorial commercial food photography, gentle warm natural window light. No hands, people, additional food, extra cups, cutlery crossing the subject or extreme lens effects. Match the provided reference's photographic palette and materials, IGNORE ALL the reference UI/text, and output only one continuous original photograph.

themeSpecs.table: Theme 04: near top-down camera at approximately 65 degrees above a honey-coloured oak cafe tabletop with diagonal wood grain, cream linen with thin forest-green stripe only at upper right edge, faint out-of-focus green leaves at far corners, warm dappled morning sunlight, whole product on a speckled cream ceramic saucer.
themeSpecs.gallery: Theme 05: camera at about 25 degrees above a low pale terracotta stone circular plinth with warm terracotta plaster wall behind, subtle olive-branch shadows on wall, muted burnt-orange palette, distant tiny cream flowers at far right edge, warm afternoon sunshine, product on speckled cream ceramic saucer centered on plinth.
